verdict.rationale: Klaviyo's pricing docs confirm users can "build automations, segmentation and reports", and it captures profile properties and behavioral events via its API and SDKs. Composer can also "build the audience". However, nothing documents segment conditions combining attributes, tags and events, or that segments update live as data changes. missing for 10: documentation of segment definition criteria (profile attributes, tags, events), evidence that segments are dynamic/auto-updating as data changes, tag-based segmentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can build audience segments from profile attributes, tags, and behavioral events, and they stay live as data changes

citations.quote: use the drag-and-drop email/SMS editors and build automations, segmentation and reports
